messages.author: 9bf5070a8dccf419
messages.subject: RI strains
parts:
Hi Karl,

What is the best way to run a qtl analysis for recombinant inbred
lines? I saw a post from October 2005 where you suggested changing the
class after loading the data set using:

>myx<-read.cross()
>class(myx)[1]<-"riself"

Is this still the best way to do this?

Thanks for your help,
Abby

messages.author: ab8dbe3bec292afe
messages.subject: Re: RI strains
parts:
Yes. Use "riself" for RIL generated by selfing and "risib"
for RIL generated by sibling mating.

R/qtl can only deal with strain averages at this point.

karl
